extracted.intended_audience: administrative law scholars, policymakers, agency officials, and legal researchers
extracted.subtask_description: A bibliographic compilation of ACUS reports, recommendations, and related statements addressing administrative law topics (rulemaking, adjudication, FOIA, penalties, dispute resolution, etc.), useful as source material for notice-and-comment and agency-procedure work.
